input: Two cards are drawn successively with replacement from a well-shuffled pack of 52 cards. What is the mean (expected number) of queens in the two draws?
thinking: There are 4 queens in 52 cards, so p = 4/52 = 1/13 for each draw. With replacement, draws are independent. Let X = number of queens in 2 draws; X ~ Binomial(n=2,p). Expected value E[X] = n*p = 2*(1/13) = 2/13.
